articles.title_en: Cournot meets Bayes-Nash: A discontinuity in behavior in finitely repeated duopoly games
articles.title_cn: 古诺遇上贝叶斯-纳什：有限重复双寡头博弈中的行为不连续性
articles.abstract_en: We conduct a series of Cournot duopoly market experiments with a high number of repetitions and fixed matching. Our treatments include markets with (a) complete cost symmetry and complete information, (b) slight cost asymmetry and complete information, and (c) varying cost asymmetries and incomplete information. For the case of complete cost symmetry and complete information, our data confirm the well-known result that duopoly players achieve, on average, partial collusion. However, as soon as any level of cost asymmetry or incomplete information is introduced, observed average individual quantities are remarkably close to the static Bayes-Nash equilibrium predictions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们进行了一系列具有高重复次数和固定匹配的古诺双寡头市场实验。我们的处理包括市场：(a)完全成本对称和完全信息，(b)轻微成本不对称和完全信息，以及(c)不同成本不对称和不完全信息。对于完全成本对称和完全信息的情况，我们的数据证实了众所周知的结果，即双寡头参与者平均实现部分合谋。然而，一旦引入任何水平的成本不对称或不完全信息，观察到的平均个体数量就与静态贝叶斯-纳什均衡预测非常接近。

articles.title_en: A stranger in a strange land: Promises and identity
articles.abstract_en: One's social identity tends to favor those belonging to one's group. At the same time, communication has had beneficial social consequences in controlled laboratory experiments. Can communication improve trust and outcomes between out-group members by making them more familiar? We construct a simple weak mechanism of group favoritism (different assigned colors) that induces in-group favoritism. Communication increases cooperation but does not affect per se the social identity gap, i.e., people make more favorable choices for in-group members. However, mutual promises are more effective for out-groups than in-groups, reducing or eliminating the social-identity gap. So perhaps, in some sense, out-group members are seen as more like in-group members when they have experienced mutual promises. We also find evidence that the two groups’ decisions are driven by different motivations, one based on expectations in-groups and one based on moral commitment in the case of out-groups.
articles.abstract_cn: 一个人的社会身份往往偏向于那些属于自己群体的人。与此同时，在受控实验室实验中，沟通已产生有益的社会后果。沟通能否通过使外群体成员更加熟悉来改善他们之间的信任和结果？我们构建了一个简单的群体偏袒弱机制（不同的指定颜色），该机制引发了内群体偏袒。沟通增加了合作，但本身并不影响社会身份差距，即人们为内群体成员做出更有利的选择。然而，相互承诺对外群体比内群体更有效，减少或消除了社会身份差距。因此，也许在某种意义上，当外群体成员经历了相互承诺后，他们被视为更像内群体成员。我们还发现证据表明，两个群体的决策由不同的动机驱动，一个基于对内群体的期望，另一个基于对外群体的道德承诺。

articles.title_en: Imposing commitment to rein in overconfidence in learning
articles.title_cn: 施加承诺以抑制学习中的过度自信
articles.abstract_en: A rational principal delegates learning to an overconfident agent who overestimates the precision of the information he collects. The principal chooses between two contracts: commitment, in which the agent commits to the duration of learning in advance, and flexible, in which the agent decides when to stop learning in real time. When the agent is sufficiently overconfident, the principal optimally ties the agent's hands by offering him the commitment contract. When the principal can choose both the contract and the agent's level of overconfidence, selecting the rational agent is suboptimal when the cost of learning is sufficiently high.
articles.abstract_cn: 一个理性的委托人将学习任务委托给一个过度自信的代理人，该代理人高估了自己所收集信息的精确度。委托人面临两种合同选择：承诺合同，即代理人预先承诺学习时长；灵活合同，即代理人实时决定何时停止学习。当代理人过度自信程度足够高时，委托人最优选择是通过提供承诺合同来束缚代理人的手脚。当委托人既能选择合同又能选择代理人的过度自信水平时，若学习成本足够高，选择理性代理人并非最优。

articles.title_en: A fair and truthful mechanism with limited subsidy
articles.title_cn: 公平真实、补贴有限的机制
articles.abstract_en: The notion of envy-freeness is a natural and intuitive fairness requirement in resource allocation. With indivisible goods, such fair allocations are not guaranteed to exist. Classical works have avoided this issue by introducing an additional divisible resource, i.e., money. In this paper, we aim to design a truthful allocation mechanism of indivisible goods to achieve fairness and efficiency criteria with a limited amount of subsidy. Following the work of Halpern and Shah, our central question is as follows: to what extent do we need to rely on the power of money to accomplish these objectives? We show that, when agents have matroidal valuations, there is a truthful allocation mechanism that achieves envy-freeness and utilitarian optimality by subsidizing each agent with at most 1, the maximum marginal contribution of each item for each agent. The design of the mechanism rests crucially on the underlying matroidal M-convexity of the Lorenz dominating allocations.
articles.abstract_cn: 无嫉妒的概念是资源分配中自然而直观的公平要求。对于不可分割的商品，这种公平分配并不能保证存在。古典作品通过引入额外的可分割资源（即金钱）来避免这个问题。在本文中，我们的目标是设计一种不可分割商品的真实分配机制，以在有限的补贴下实现公平和效率的标准。继哈尔彭和沙阿的研究之后，我们的核心问题是：我们需要在多大程度上依靠金钱的力量来实现这些目标？我们证明，当代理人具有矩阵估值时，存在一种真实的分配机制，通过最多补贴每个代理人1（每个项目对每个代理人的最大边际贡献）来实现无嫉妒和功利主义最优性。该机制的设计关键取决于洛伦兹主导分配的潜在拟阵 M 凸性。

articles.title_en: Large random matching markets with localized preference structures can exhibit large cores
articles.title_cn: 具有局部偏好结构的大型随机匹配市场可能表现出大型核
articles.abstract_en: I present a class of models for random matching markets with non-homogeneous agent preferences, drawn from the computer science literature on network structure. An analogue of the Watts–Strogatz (1998) ‘small-world’ network model supports significant incentives to manipulate matching outcomes. The scope for manipulation remains substantial as markets become large and unbalanced—contrasting prior work which found little scope under uniform or homogeneous random preferences. This scope for manipulation directly corresponds to core size and differences in agents' welfare between core outcomes. These results suggest largeness and cross-side imbalance may be insufficient to fully explain small cores in matching markets; I discuss alternative explanations.
articles.abstract_cn: 我提出了一类具有非均匀代理人偏好的随机匹配市场模型，这些模型借鉴了计算机科学中关于网络结构的文献。瓦茨-斯特罗加茨（Watts–Strogatz，1998）‘小世界’网络模型的类似物支持操纵匹配结果的显著激励。随着市场变得庞大且不平衡，操纵的空间仍然很大——这与先前在均匀或同质随机偏好下发现操纵空间很小的研究形成对比。这种操纵空间直接对应于核的大小以及核结果之间代理人福利的差异。这些结果表明，市场的规模和跨侧不平衡可能不足以完全解释匹配市场中的小型核；我讨论了其他解释。

articles.title_en: Reinforcement learning in a prisoner's dilemma
articles.title_cn: 囚徒困境中的强化学习
articles.abstract_en: I characterize the outcomes of a class of model-free reinforcement learning algorithms, such as stateless Q-learning, in a prisoner's dilemma. The behavior is studied in the limit as players stop experimenting after sufficiently exploring their options. A closed form relationship between the learning rate and game payoffs reveals whether the players will learn to cooperate or defect. The findings have implications for algorithmic collusion and also apply to asymmetric learners with different experimentation rules.
articles.abstract_cn: 我刻画了一类无模型强化学习算法（如无状态Q学习）在囚徒困境中的结果。在玩家充分探索其选项后停止试验的极限情况下研究该行为。学习率与博弈收益之间的闭式关系揭示了玩家将学会合作还是背叛。这些发现对算法合谋具有启示意义，也适用于具有不同试验规则的不对称学习者。

articles.title_en: Queueing games with an endogenous number of machines
articles.title_cn: 内生机器数量的排队博弈
articles.abstract_en: We study queueing problems with an endogenous number of machines, the novelty being that coalitions not only choose how to queue, but on how many machines. After minimizing the processing costs and machine costs, we share the proceeds of this cooperation, and study the existence of stable allocations. First, we study queueing problems, and examine how to share the total cost. We provide an upper bound and a lower bound on the cost of a machine to guarantee the non-emptiness of the core. Next, we study requeueing problems, where there is an existing queue. We examine how to share the cost savings compared to the initial situation, when optimally requeueing/changing the number of machines. Although stable allocations may not exist, we guarantee their existence when all machines are considered public goods, and we start with an initial queue in which agents with larger waiting costs are processed first.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究具有内生机器数量的排队问题，新颖之处在于联盟不仅选择如何排队，还选择使用多少台机器。在最小化处理成本和机器成本之后，我们分享这种合作的收益，并研究稳定配置的存在性。首先，我们研究排队问题，并考察如何分摊总成本。我们提供了机器成本的上界和下界，以保证核心的非空性。接下来，我们研究重新排队问题，其中存在一个现有队列。我们考察在最优地重新排队/改变机器数量时，如何分享相对于初始情况的成本节约。尽管稳定配置可能不存在，但当所有机器被视为公共物品，并且我们从初始队列开始，其中等待成本较大的代理先被处理时，我们保证其存在性。

articles.title_en: Incomplete preferences or incomplete information? On Rationalizability in games with private values
articles.title_cn: 不完全偏好还是不完整信息？论私有价值博弈中的理性化
articles.abstract_en: I propose a notion of Rationalizability, called Incomplete Preference Rationalizability, for games with incomplete preferences. Under an appropriate topological condition, the incomplete preference rationalizable set is non-empty and compact. I argue that incomplete orderings can be used to model incomplete information in strategic settings. Drawing on this connection, I show that in games with private values the sets of incomplete preference rationalizable actions, of belief-free rationalizable actions (Battigalli et al., 2011; Bergemann and Morris, 2017), and of interim correlated rationalizable actions (Dekel et al., 2007) of the universal type space coincide.
articles.abstract_cn: 我提出了一种理性化的概念，称为不完全偏好理性化，适用于具有不完全偏好的博弈。在适当的拓扑条件下，不完全偏好理性化集合是非空且紧致的。我认为不完全排序可以用来模拟战略环境中的不完整信息。基于这一联系，我证明了在私有价值博弈中，不完全偏好理性化行动集、无信念理性化行动集（Battigalli等，2011；Bergemann和Morris，2017）以及普遍类型空间的临时相关理性化行动集（Dekel等，2007）是一致的。

articles.title_en: Dynamic coordination with payoff and informational externalities
articles.title_cn: 具有收益和信息外部性的动态协调
articles.abstract_en: I study a two-player continuous-time dynamic coordination game with observational learning. Each player has one opportunity to make a reversible investment with an uncertain return that is realized only when both players invest. Each player learns about the potential return by observing a private signal and the actions of the other player. In equilibrium, players' roles as leader and follower are endogenously determined. Information aggregates in a single burst initially, then gradually through delayed investment and disinvestment over time. More precise signals lead to faster coordination conditional on initial disagreement, but might also increase the probability of initial disagreement.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了一个具有观察学习的两人连续时间动态协调博弈。每个玩家有一次机会进行可逆投资，其不确定的回报仅在两个玩家都投资时实现。每个玩家通过观察私人信号和其他玩家的行动来了解潜在回报。在均衡中，玩家作为领导者和追随者的角色是内生决定的。信息最初以单一爆发形式聚合，然后通过延迟投资和撤资随时间逐渐聚合。更精确的信号在初始分歧条件下导致更快的协调，但也可能增加初始分歧的概率。

articles.title_en: Dominated choices under deferred acceptance mechanism: The effect of admission selectivity
articles.title_cn: 延迟接受机制下的支配选择：录取选择性的影响
articles.abstract_en: College applicants often make dominated choices even when a strategically simple mechanism such as deferred acceptance is in place. We study Hungarian college admissions, where deferred acceptance is used, and still many college applicants make revealed dominated choices: they forgo the free opportunity to receive a tuition waiver. Using two empirical strategies, we show that when admission with a tuition waiver becomes more selective, applicants make more revealed dominated choices. Our results suggest that dominated choices respond to economic incentives.
articles.abstract_cn: 即使存在延迟接受等策略简单机制，大学申请者仍经常做出支配选择。我们研究了匈牙利大学招生，其中使用了延迟接受机制，但仍有许多大学申请者做出显性支配选择：他们放弃了获得学费减免的免费机会。使用两种实证策略，我们表明当带有学费减免的录取更具选择性时，申请者会做出更多显性支配选择。我们的结果表明，支配选择对经济激励有反应。

articles.title_cn: 基于共同所有权的合伙关系
articles.abstract_en: In a unifying framework generalizing established theories we characterize under which conditions Joint Ownership of assets creates the best cooperation incentives in a partnership. We endogenise renegotiation costs and assume that they weakly increase with additional assets. A salient sufficient condition for optimal cooperation incentives among patient partners is if Joint Ownership is a Strict Coasian Institution for which transaction costs impede an efficient asset reallocation after a breakdown. In contrast to Halonen (2002) the logic behind our results is that Joint Ownership maximizes the value of the relationship and the costs of renegotiating ownership after a broken relationship.
articles.abstract_cn: 在一个统一框架中，我们概括了既有理论，刻画了在何种条件下资产的共同所有权能在合伙关系中创造最佳的合作激励。我们将重新谈判成本内生化，并假设其随资产增加而弱递增。一个显著且充分的条件是，在耐心的合伙人之间实现最优合作激励，即共同所有权是一种严格的科斯式制度，在这种制度下，交易成本阻碍了关系破裂后的有效资产重新配置。与Halonen（2002）相反，我们结果的逻辑在于，共同所有权最大化了关系的价值以及关系破裂后重新谈判所有权的成本。

articles.title_en: Impartial selection with additive guarantees via iterated deletion
articles.title_cn: 通过迭代删除实现具有加性保证的公正选择
articles.abstract_en: Impartial selection is the selection of an individual from a group based on nominations by other members of the group, in such a way that individuals cannot influence their own chance of selection. For this problem, we give a deterministic mechanism with an additive performance guarantee of O(n(1+κ)/2) in a setting with n individuals where each individual casts O(nκ) nominations, where κ∈[0,1]. This bound is O(n) for κ=0 and O(n) for κ=1. The latter is trivial, as even a mechanism that never selects provides an additive guarantee of n−1. We show, however, that it is also best possible: for every deterministic impartial mechanism there exists a situation in which some individual is nominated by every other individual and the mechanism either does not select or selects an individual not nominated by anyone.
articles.abstract_cn: 公正选择是指根据群体中其他成员的提名从群体中选择一个个体，且个体不能影响自己被选中的机会。针对这一问题，我们给出了一种确定性机制，在n个个体的环境中，每个个体提出O(nκ)次提名，其中κ∈[[0],1]，该机制具有O(n(1+κ)/2)的加性性能保证。对于κ=0，该界为O(n)；对于κ=1，该界为O(n)。后者是平凡的，因为即使一个从不选择的机制也能提供n−1的加性保证。然而，我们证明这也是最优的：对于每一个确定性公正机制，都存在一种情况，其中某个个体被所有其他个体提名，而该机制要么不选择，要么选择一个未被任何人提名的个体。

articles.title_en: Learning in networks with idiosyncratic agents
articles.title_cn: 具有特质个体的网络中的学习
articles.abstract_en: Individuals update their beliefs and respond to new information in idiosyncratic ways. I show that an individual's idiosyncrasies such as under-reaction, over-reaction, or frustration can have spillover effects and adversely affect the long run beliefs of society. I derive sufficient conditions for convergence of beliefs for all possible networks of agents with heterogeneous idiosyncrasies. Beliefs converge if the magnitude of over-reaction and frustration in any agent's network neighbourhood is below a threshold determined by how much they trust their own private signals. I find that the absence of disproportionately influential agents is not sufficient to ensure the accuracy of long-run beliefs if learning idiosyncrasies also grow with the network. Finally, I show that agent under-reaction can partition the network, create bottlenecks, and delay convergence. Simulations on artificial and Indian village networks validate the results.
articles.abstract_cn: 个体以特质化的方式更新信念并对新信息作出反应。我表明，个体的特质，如反应不足、反应过度或挫败感，可能产生溢出效应，并对社会的长期信念产生不利影响。我推导出信念收敛的充分条件，适用于所有具有异质性特质的个体网络。如果任何个体网络邻域中反应过度和挫败感的程度低于由其对自己私人信号的信任程度决定的阈值，则信念收敛。我发现，如果学习特质也随网络增长，则缺乏影响力过大的个体并不足以确保长期信念的准确性。最后，我表明个体反应不足可以将网络分割，造成瓶颈，并延迟收敛。在人工网络和印度村庄网络上的模拟验证了这些结果。

articles.title_en: Shining with the stars: Competition, screening, and concern for coworkers' quality
articles.title_cn: 与星同辉：竞争、筛选与对同事质量的关注
articles.abstract_en: We study how workers' concern for coworkers' ability (CfCA) affects competition in the labor market. Two firms offer nonlinear contracts to a unit mass of prospective workers. Firms may differ in their marginal productivity, while workers are heterogeneous in their ability (high or low) and their taste for being employed by any of the two firms. Workers receive a utility premium when employed by the firm hiring most high-ability workers and suffer a utility loss if hired by its competitor. These premiums/losses are endogenously determined.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究工人对同事能力的关注（CfCA）如何影响劳动力市场的竞争。两家企业向单位质量的潜在工人提供非线性合同。企业可能在边际生产率上存在差异，而工人在能力（高或低）以及受雇于两家企业中任何一家的偏好方面具有异质性。当受雇于雇佣最多高能力工人的企业时，工人获得效用溢价，若被其竞争对手雇佣则遭受效用损失。这些溢价/损失是内生决定的。

articles.title_en: Information disclosure in mitigating moral hazard: An experimental investigation
articles.title_cn: 信息披露在缓解道德风险中的作用：一项实验研究
articles.abstract_en: In a moral hazard framework, an agent considers undertaking a task of uncertain difficulty. An immediate disclosure of the task's difficulty by the principal convinces the agent to perform only easy tasks. By contrast, information design theory predicts that delayed disclosure can induce the agent to continue working even when the work turns out to be challenging. Our experimental evidence confirms that delayed disclosure outperforms immediate disclosure and no disclosure, as theory predicts, but only if immediate disclosure is not available. However, when the principal is faced with the choice between the two policies and chooses delayed disclosure over immediate disclosure, the superiority of delayed disclosure disappears due to the agent's intention-based reciprocity towards the principal.
articles.abstract_cn: 在道德风险框架下，代理人考虑承担一项难度不确定的任务。委托人立即披露任务难度会使代理人确信只执行简单的任务。相比之下，信息设计理论预测，延迟披露可以诱导代理人即使在任务变得具有挑战性时也继续工作。我们的实验证据证实，延迟披露优于立即披露和不披露，正如理论所预测，但仅在立即披露不可用的情况下。然而，当委托人在两种政策之间面临选择并选择延迟披露而非立即披露时，延迟披露的优越性因代理人对委托人的基于意图的互惠而消失。

articles.title_cn: 加权选民下的流行匹配
articles.abstract_en: We consider a natural generalization of the well-known Popular Matching problem where every vertex has a weight. We call a matching M more popular than matching M′ if the weight of vertices preferring M to M′ is larger than the weight of vertices preferring M′ to M. For this case, we show that it is NP-hard to find a popular matching. Our main result is a polynomial-time algorithm that delivers a popular matching or a proof for its non-existence in instances where all vertices on one side have weight c for some c>3 and all vertices on the other side have weight 1.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑众所周知的流行匹配问题的一个自然推广，其中每个顶点都有一个权重。如果偏好匹配M而非匹配M′的顶点权重之和大于偏好匹配M′而非匹配M的顶点权重之和，则称匹配M比匹配M′更流行。对于这种情况，我们证明找到流行匹配是NP难的。我们的主要结果是一个多项式时间算法，该算法在实例中所有一侧顶点的权重为某个c>3且另一侧所有顶点的权重为1时，能够给出一个流行匹配或证明其不存在。

articles.title_en: The impact of fraud on reputation systems
articles.title_cn: 欺诈对声誉系统的影响
articles.abstract_en: Reputation systems can mitigate opportunistic behavior and improve efficiency on online marketplaces. However, rating fraud is a major problem on many websites. We experimentally investigate the circumstances under which rating fraud undermines the functioning of a reputation system and reduces efficiency. We find that the ability to manipulate feedback received from others generally reduces the reliability of displayed ratings compared to a control treatment where rating fraud is not possible. When manipulation is possible and costless, rating fraud is widespread, ratings become less reliable, expectations are lower, and efficiency is significantly reduced. However, when there is a cost to manipulation, there is less fraud, ratings are more reliable and efficiency increases, even when the cost is comparatively low.
articles.abstract_cn: 声誉系统可以减轻机会主义行为并提高在线市场的效率。然而，评分欺诈是许多网站上的一个主要问题。我们通过实验研究了评分欺诈在何种情况下会破坏声誉系统的功能并降低效率。我们发现，与无法进行评分欺诈的对照处理相比，操纵他人反馈的能力通常会降低显示评分的可靠性。当操纵可能且无成本时，欺诈行为普遍存在，评分可靠性降低，预期下降，效率显著降低。然而，当操纵存在成本时，欺诈减少，评分更可靠，效率提高，即使成本相对较低也是如此。

articles.title_en: Multi-dimensional reasoning in competitive resource allocation games: Evidence from intra-team communication
articles.title_cn: 竞争性资源分配博弈中的多维推理：来自团队内部沟通的证据
articles.abstract_en: We experimentally investigate behavior and reasoning in various competitive resource allocation games with large strategy spaces. In the experiment, a team of two players plays as one entity against other teams. Team members communicate with one another before choosing a strategy. We analyze their messages using three different classification approaches and find that the vast majority of players think in terms of dimensions or characteristics of strategies rather than in terms of individual elements of the strategy space. Furthermore, the dimensions’ metric allows linking the reasoning across the different games. Thus, we suggest that multi-dimensional reasoning is a frequently used decision procedure that connects the behavior observed in various resource allocation games.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过实验研究了具有大策略空间的多种竞争性资源分配博弈中的行为和推理。在实验中，一个由两名玩家组成的团队作为一个整体与其他团队对抗。团队成员在选择策略前会相互沟通。我们使用三种不同的分类方法分析他们的消息，发现绝大多数玩家是从策略的维度或特征而非策略空间的单个元素来思考的。此外，维度的度量使得能够将不同博弈中的推理联系起来。因此，我们提出多维推理是一种常用的决策过程，它连接了在各种资源分配博弈中观察到的行为。

articles.title_en: Beyond dominance and Nash: Ranking equilibria by critical mass
articles.title_cn: 超越占优与纳什：按临界质量对均衡排序
articles.abstract_en: Strategic interactions pose central issues that are not adequately explained by the traditional concepts of dominant strategy equilibrium (DSE), Nash equilibrium (NE), and their refinements. A comprehensive analysis of equilibrium concepts within the von Neumann-Nash framework of n-person optimization reveals a decreasing hierarchy of n nested concepts ranging from DSE to NE. These concepts are defined by the “critical mass,” the number of players needed to adopt and sustain the play of a strategy profile as an equilibrium. In games with n>2 players, the n−2 intermediate concepts explain strategic issues in large social systems, implementation, decentralization, as well as replication studied in economics, operations management, and political games.
articles.abstract_cn: 战略互动提出了核心问题，而传统的主导策略均衡（DSE）、纳什均衡（NE）及其精炼概念未能充分解释这些问题。在冯·诺依曼-纳什的n人优化框架内对均衡概念进行全面分析，揭示了一个从DSE到NE递减的n个嵌套概念的层级。这些概念由“临界质量”定义，即采用并维持一个策略组合作为均衡所需的玩家数量。在n>2人的博弈中，n−2个中间概念解释了大型社会系统中的战略问题、实施、分权，以及经济学、运营管理和政治博弈中研究的复制现象。
